exposure: Hospitals ranked by risk-adjusted and unadjusted rates of prelabor cesarean
Admission characteristics (weekend vs. weekday, scheduled vs. unscheduled)
outcome: Prelabor cesarean delivery in women without prior cesarean
cohort: 408,355 women without prior cesareans delivering at 254 hospitals in California
finding: Risk adjustment for patient factors substantially changes hospital rankings for prelabor cesarean deliveries, highlighting the importance of considering patient characteristics when assessing hospital performance on this quality metric.
mod_finding: This study investigated the need for risk adjustment when assessing hospitals based on rates of prelabor cesarean deliveries in women without prior cesareans.
